36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
81219: He is a regular high school student who has a curse that he calls "Absolute Choice". This curse will at random times cause a voice in his head to give him two or more choices to make.
81221: A carefree and upbeat girl who claims to have come to Kanade to help free him of his "Absolute Choice" curse. However, ends up having amnesia on arrival and becomes very little help at all. Enjoys sweets and particularly chocolate.
81223: Kanade's classmate who is quiet but a little weird. She likes verbally abusing Kanade.
81225: One of the Reject 5 members. She is a very cheerful and happy girl. She also likes Kanade and doesn't mind being a 5th wheel.
81227: Kanade's homeroom teacher who looks like a little kid. She is one of the people who knows about Kanade's multiple choice problem, and was afflicted by it herself. Her learnings from it help Kanade with his missions and choices.
81229: Ayame is a proud, rich lady. She's haughty and her cold attitude earns her great support from a portion of the masochistic men. She's in Class 2-10, and fifth in the popularity ranking. Her large breasts attract a lot of attention, especially from the boys.
81231: She's the fair and beautiful student council president whose reigned at the top of popularity rankings for three semesters in a row. She has a gentle air and a meek demeanor, but she's always smiling to hide her true feelings.
87873: A housewife who lives nearby Kanade.
87874: A senior student and a member of the Reject Five. He's known as the one of the leading weirdos at school and is always wearing a mask.
87875: One of the popularity five. He has a crush on Chocolat.
87876: Yuuouji's best friend. She is very pure at heart and very innocent. She often feels very embarrassed around male students, as she rarely spends time around them, but wants to learn to do so.
87878: Kanade's childhood friend who is one year younger than him. She had gone to America, but transferred into Seikou Academy due to her parents' circumstances. She calls Kanade "Onii-chan," but she also feels great joy in being "someone's little sister.
327298: Ouka's mother and the wife of Ouma. Former idol, now works as news commentator.
